entries.scenario: Uppercase destructive command must still classify destructive and fail a tight allowlist
Homoglyph command the classifier misses must still be refused by deny-by-default allowlist
Slug traversal and absolute inputs must be refused by the evidence jail, never joined

entries.risk: gate escape via separators and command substitution
entries.scenario: Gate with ; plus $(...) or backtick payload must be refused even when the outer token is allowlisted
Oversized hostile stdout must be truncated, sha-pinned, and round-trip byte-identical

entries.risk: miner poisoning via corrupt receipt interleaved
entries.scenario: Corrupt receipt between healthy ones is skipped and counted while healthy flow continues; strict list aborts
Batch stops at the first failing gate: honest partial receipts, no further execution

entries.risk: timeout abuse via zero or huge values
entries.scenario: Timeout 0 clamps to the default and huge timeouts clamp to the max, observed on outcomes
